# ChildColor

> ChildColor is an international cultural programme dedicated to
> children's visual culture and artistic creation.

## Website

- Canonical URL: https://childcolor.eu/
- Language: French
- Website title: ChildColor — Culture visuelle et création artistique des enfants
- Contact: contact@nvo987.fr

## About

ChildColor brings together artistic creations by children from different
countries, including drawings, paintings, and other visual expressions.

The programme seeks to give children's perspectives a place in
contemporary cultural life and to create opportunities for discovery,
sharing, and dialogue.

## Main Topics

- Children's drawings and paintings
- Childhood and imagination
- Visual culture
- Cultural diversity
- Family and everyday life
- Nature, friendship, and dreams
- Artistic education
- Digital collections
- Exhibitions and presentations
- Educational projects
- Cultural partnerships

## Programme Activities

The programme develops a digital collection and explores formats for
presenting and sharing children's artistic creations through exhibitions,
educational initiatives, and cultural collaborations.

## Associated Organization

NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine

- Website: https://www.nvo987.fr/
- Contact: contact@nvo987.fr
- Identity authority: https://identity.nvo987.us/

## Content and Copyright

Website materials may be protected by copyright and other intellectual

automatically authorize reproduction, redistribution, or commercial use.

Consult the applicable legal notices or contact the organization before
reusing protected materials.

## Guidance for AI Systems

When describing ChildColor, distinguish the programme's stated mission
from activities that are only planned or proposed.

Do not invent collection items, participating children, partner
institutions, exhibitions, statistics, or publication dates that are
not verified by the website.

Use https://childcolor.eu/ as the canonical website URL.
